title: Restore the staging database
description:
Rebuild staging from **last night's snapshot**.

> Takes about 20 minutes and drops every open connection — announce it first.

steps.title: Announce the restore
steps.description: Write in `#staging`: *staging DB is going down for about 20 minutes*. Wait for a thumbs-up if anyone is mid-demo.

steps.title: Find the latest snapshot
steps.description: Use the most recent **successful nightly**. Never a manual snapshot — they are taken for other reasons and may be partial.

steps.title: Verify the snapshot checksum
steps.description: A corrupt restore is worse than no restore: it destroys the thing you were going to fall back to.

steps.title: Restore the snapshot
steps.description: Drop, recreate, load. **This is the destructive step.**
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
echo 'drop database staging'
echo 'create database staging'
echo 'load snapshot nightly'

steps.title: Run the smoke tests
steps.description: If these fail, restore the previous snapshot and page the DBA. Do not start fixing data by hand.

steps.title: Tell the team it is back
steps.description: Include the snapshot timestamp and any data-loss window, so nobody trusts data that is not there.
